name: anf-tauri-toolkit
description: Project-specific Tauri v2 documentation and read-only source inspection for AnF development.

interface.longDescription: Uses official Tauri v2 references and a bundled read-only Python inspector to check the real project's configuration, plugins, capabilities and missing resource mappings. No hosted server, credentials or app runtime changes. Independently maintained for AnF; not an official Tauri plugin.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this AnF checkout and use official Tauri v2 guidance to plan and verify the next change.
